comment.body: Thanks for clarifying that the workspace contained Edge, Firefox, and Outlook, and that removing/readding Firefox temporarily made launch correct. The first bugreport did not include that workspace, and another report changed after editing entries. Could you confirm whether Tor still launches instead of Firefox on your current PowerToys version and provide the Firefox entry’s displayed application/path from the workspace editor (redact personal profile paths)? This distinguishes stale workspace identity from launch resolution; no generic logs are needed.
